body:
Parent: #1715
Depends on: #2158, #2159, #1713, #1601

## 原子目标

在测试专用 moderation composition root 中暴露最小 moderation lifecycle、region policy、signal/evidence 与 queue projection ports，使 fixture producer 通过真实 moderation application/domain/repository/read-model 语义确定性准备 pending、approved、rejected、spam、region matrix、signal matrix 与 queue matrix 状态。本 issue 只提供审核事实，不创建 thread/version/delete facts或最终 producer。

## 必须交付

1. Ports 仅 test-fixture composition root 可用，调用绑定 current run/namespace/profile/capability、#2159 comment ref、#1713 admin actor ref、policy/reason/region/signal semantic IDs、#1601 temporal context 与 owner identity；production HTTP/普通 DI 不可访问。
2. Pending/approved/rejected/spam 等状态转换必须调用真实 moderation application/domain/repository ports，维护 status/reason/version/timestamps/audit/outbox/cache/invalidation；禁止 direct SQL、fixture-private enum 或只改 status integer。
3. Region matrix 至少覆盖两个 current policy/region states，记录真实 policy identity、reason、jurisdiction applicability 与 decision evidence；不得用字符串标签冒充关系。
4. Signal/evidence matrix 使用现有生产 signal/provider/evidence contracts，精确绑定 comment、source/provider/version/score/classification/evidence refs；不能在 fixture 中复制第二信号算法或写自由文本。
5. Queue projection逐状态验证 exact include/exclude、bucket/group/reason/order/actor visibility 与 admin read model；`queue count > 0`或取第一条不合格。
6. Public projection逐状态验证 approved可见、pending/rejected/spam按当前政策不可见或受限；与DB/current version/cache generation exact一致。
7. 每个互斥moderation/region/signal capability使用独立 comment identity或明确独立 moderation operation，不在同一comment连续改状态后只保留最终快照。
8. Admin actor/permission只消费#1713 narrow refs，不创建或提升admin权限；comment/thread只消费#2159 refs，不创建article/user或修改security state。
9. Rerun/idempotency只修改owned moderation/signals/evidence/queue facts，不累计duplicate evidence/audit/outbox或清理其他profiles。
10. Partial DB/read-model/cache/queue/evidence failure不得发布verified result；failure/cancel保留recovery receipt。
11. Result receipts记录comment/status/reason/region/policy/signal/evidence/queue/public-admin projection/cache/audit refs与content digest，不记录private signal payload或credential。
12. Independent verifier通过真实moderation query、public/admin reads与queue/cache observations验证postconditions。
13. Static governance禁止direct moderation SQL、queue-count pass、first-pending discovery、free-form region/signal labels、legacy statuses与test port production exposure。

## 固定约束

- 不实现thread/version/delete ports，归#2159。
- 不实现最终producer或legacy removal。
- 不修改产品moderation policies/reasons/signals/queue semantics。
- 不创建article/auth/security数据。
- 不修改#1794。

## 必须测试

- pending appears public；
- approved missing public；
- rejected/spam wrong queue bucket；
- status integer changed without reason/audit/history；
- region evidence missing/text-only；
- signal provider/version/evidence mismatch；
- queue count >0/first row；
- same comment reused all states；
- direct SQL/private enums；
- admin permission modified；
- rerun duplicate evidence/audit；
- partial cache/queue/read-model still verified；
- receipt/projection tamper。

## 验收条件

- [ ] Moderation/region/signal/evidence/queue ports真实、test-only、owner-bound。
- [ ] Status、reason、policy、evidence、public/admin/queue/cache postconditions完整一致。
- [ ] Queue exact membership而非count/first-match，互斥states不互相覆盖。
- [ ] Partial/unknown/legacy/direct-storage全部fail closed。
- [ ] 本PR不实现thread facts或最终producer。

## 非目标

- 不实现comment thread/version/delete。
- 不生成aggregate comment fixture receipt。
- 不删除demo/legacy helpers。
- 不测试moderation HTTP UI flow。

Closed via #3484 (squash 810ab6476cfe7d136ee43555cf434f633b1e5533).

- Status transitions go through production IAuthoringModerationCommands; reason/admin actor/audit/outbox verified per state.
- Queue membership is exact: full pagination with repeated-cursor and duplicate-identity rejection, per-state include/exclude + bucket/group/reason/order/actor visibility, independent admin read-model read.
- Per-state cache observation via production cursor counter (article:<id> identity, numeric generation).
- Runtime state is owner-bound lease/restore with exact prior-state digest and tamper rejection.
- Independent cleanup observation proves soft-delete + queue absence + public hiding.
- Real Docker PostgreSQL+Redis lane (comments-moderation, run issue-2160-2161-verify-r1): fsusblog.fixture-receipt.v2 terminalStatus=verified, digest sha256:64e76b127ae40a562d8e7c65778f9108e4ef3aa470408747f83e1e58aadb036d; cleanup terminal state cleaned, second cleanup run also cleaned (idempotent).
